name: jvm_parser

scripts.test: javac test/HelloWorld.java && npx disassembler test/HelloWorld.class > test/actual_output.txt && diff -u test/actual_output.txt test/expected_output.txt
scripts.test:wide: javac test/RealWide.java && npx disassembler test/RealWide.class > test/actual_output_wide.txt && diff -u test/actual_output_wide.txt test/expected_output_wide.txt

author: kreijstal
description: A command-line tool to disassemble Java class files.
